_comment: WAF rulesets for BMBA. Managed + custom rules. Apply via Cloudflare dashboard / rulesets API / Terraform.

bot_fight_mode.comment: API clients are non-browser; enforce via custom UA/rate rules instead.

custom_rules.name: Admin: allowlist countries
custom_rules.expression: http.host eq "admin.bmba.com" and ip.geoip.country not in {"SA" "AE" "KW" "QA" "BH" "OM" "EG" "JO" "US" "DE" "GB"}
custom_rules.description: Access to admin console only from approved countries (adjust to ops team). Not a substitute for backend RBAC.

custom_rules.name: API: admin requires Access session
custom_rules.expression: starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/admin") and not cf.verified_bot and not any(http.request.headers["cf-access-jwt-assertion"][*] matches ".*")
custom_rules.description: When Cloudflare Access is enabled on admin API, block requests without a CF Access JWT. Backend RBAC still enforced.

custom_rules.name: Abuse: bad ASNs
custom_rules.description: Populate with known-abuse ASN list; maintained regularly. Placeholder set.

custom_rules.name: Skip security for health/static
custom_rules.expression: any(http.request.uri.path matches "^/(\.well-known|healthz|favicon\.ico)$") or any(http.request.headers["content-type"][*] matches "application/json") and any(http.request.method == "OPTIONS")
